title: Biome colours
description: 1848 custom biomes with sky and water colors compromised of 42 interchangeable colors
body:
# Biome Colours

**Minecraft 1.21+ Datapack**

Complete sky & water color variants for plains biomes.

---

## How to Use

All variants are plains biome overrides. Use the `/fillbiome` command to apply them:

    /fillbiome <region_selector> <biome_variant>

- Example:  
      /fillbiome ~ ~ ~ 10 sky_twilightblue-water_algae  
  → Sets all sky in the region to **twilight blue** and all water to **algae green**.

- Sky-only: `sky_twilightblue`  
- Water-only: `water_algae`

> Replace `<region_selector>` with your coordinates or selection (like `~ ~ ~ 10` for a 10-block radius).

---

## Included Colors
skyblue, clearday, deepsky, twilightblue, midnight,  
sunsetorange, goldenhour, softpink, roseglow, crimsonsky,  
lavender, neonpurple, magenta, voidpurple, royalviolet,  
toxicgreen, limeglow, emerald, mutedgreen, swampfog,  
voidblack, charcoal, stormgray, ashengray, fogwhite,  
oceanblue, deepocean, tropicalcyan, lightaqua, arcticice,  
swampgreen, murkygreen, algae, darkmoss,  
mysticpurple, voidindigo, enchantedblue, neoncyan,  
lavatint, bloodred, amber, rust

---

## Notes

- Each variant is a **plains biome override** — does not affect other biomes.  
- Fog and water fog colors are derived automatically from the sky/water colors.  
- Works in Minecraft 1.21+ (pack format 48).  
- Perfect for screenshots, cinematic worlds, or creative builds.
- there are plans for grass and leaves support in future versions
